findings.title: Plugin completion logs drop traceID
findings.body: logRequest no longer appends traceID from tracing.TraceIDFromContext, and ContextualLoggerMiddleware only puts endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID, and uname on the context. The "Plugin Request Completed" / grafana-data-egress line therefore no longer carries a trace id, so those logs can no longer be correlated with the request trace. Put traceID back on the log params (or into the contextual attributes) before relying on FromContext.

findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext drops recorded logs
findings.body: FromContext ignores the receiver and returns NewTestLogger(). LoggerMiddleware now logs via logger.FromContext(ctx).Info, so any test that injects a TestLogger and asserts InfoLogs will see zero calls: the Info lands on a different instance. FromContext should return the same TestLogger (or a child that still records into it).
